title: Breakfast gig, Birmingham job and why he drinks ice water
summary: They once played a jazz breakfast; a Birmingham job is recalled and Zanco explains he drinks only ice water on the stand because drink spoils his lip and fingers.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road
